name: Wristband of Missile Deflection
body:
Price 4,000 gp; Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This gold wristband provides a +1 shield bonus as though it is a buckler, but without the armor check penalty or arcane spell failure chance of a buckler. Furthermore, the shield bonus is always active, regardless of whether its wearer is using their arm bearing the wristband to wield a weapon or cast a spell with a somatic component. Additionally, once per day, as an immediate action, if the wearer has at least one hand free when they would normally be hit with an attack from a ranged weapon, they may deflect it with the wristband, taking no damage from it, as if they had the Deflect Arrows feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells protection from arrows; Cost 2,000 gp
